introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under butt and your hands under shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Don't lift your knee higher than your back.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS LEFT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Don't lift your knee higher than your back.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your stomach with your knees bent and heels squeezed together.\n\nThen lift your feet up and down. The exercise is very effective at squeezing your butt.
name: FROGGY GLUTE LIFTS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core engaged.
Use the strength of your glutes when lifting your legs.
Don't lift your upper body when lifting your feet.
Exhale when lifting your feet, and inhale when lowering them.
You should feel your glutes burning.
This exercise really targets your butt.
This exercise is good for your lower back.

introduce:
Stand with your hands on your hips and feet a little wider than shoulder width apart.

Then lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. 

Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your tiptoes.
name: PLIE SQUATS

tips.text: Focus on your heels to support your body.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Don't lean your body forward.
Inhale as you squat down, and exhale as you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
This exercise strengthens your gluteus, quadriceps and hips.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Bend your arms in front of you to keep balance. \n\nLower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. Come half way up instead of coming all the way up, then squat down again. Repeat.
name: SQUAT PULSES

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your glutes really on fire.
Please keep your back straight.
